description: Golden queries: find the metric (and its table) that answers a data question. Warehouse answers directly, without the SQL review gate, as {"models_selected": [...], "proposed_sql": [...]} (empty lists when it cannot tell). Scores the selected source, that the proposed SQL reads the right table and compiles on Trino (EXPLAIN only, nothing runs), that the table was found, that no gate tool was used, and a 12-call budget.

cases.name: find_unique_products_sold_excl_ltd_metric
cases.query: For standard Datapark and EXP Wish commerce reporting, which metric counts distinct products sold excluding Limited Time Deal products at payment-received variation grain? Answer from the metric catalog and table schemas only: do not request SQL approval and do not run any SQL. Reply with a single JSON object only, with no markdown fences and no other text: {"models_selected": ["<database>.<table>.<metric>"], "proposed_sql": ["<one read-only Trino SQL query that answers the question>"]}. If you cannot determine them, leave the lists empty: {"models_selected": [], "proposed_sql": []}.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT dt, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS unique_products_sold FROM core_data.fct_transaction_variations WHERE dt BETWEEN '${start_dt}' AND '${end_dt}' AND is_ltd_product = 'false' GROUP BY dt
cases.notes: Golden query from branch ci-add-golden-query-benchmark (observability/cases/functional/databot.json), written for Databot; run against Warehouse.
